entries.description: wallstreet is a free, open-source (Apache-2.0) program that turns a terminal into a trading-desk screen with tmux: a table of the most active stocks, three tickers for gainers, losers and headlines, a feed reader and press photos as ASCII art. The quotes come from the Nasdaq market-movers API without an API key, the news from RSS feeds of BBC, CNBC, MarketWatch and the WSJ. A demo mode shows invented companies and headlines without any network request. It began as the sister program of Dustin Kirkland's hollywood and was rebuilt with data sources that answer; it runs on macOS and Linux and needs Python 3 and tmux.
